title: Fine Structure
description: Build and host full-stack apps from a prompt, with agents that reach you on WhatsApp and email.
summary: Build and host full-stack apps from a prompt, with agents that reach you on WhatsApp and email.
offersHint: Build and host full-stack apps from a prompt, with agents that reach you on WhatsApp and email. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://finestructure.ai/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: create_app
toolsPreview.description: Create a new application from a natural language prompt. The AI generates a complete web app with pages, components, styling, and data models. Returns a job_id - poll get_job_status to track progress. When the job is done, the app is ready.

toolsPreview.name: agency_create_client
toolsPreview.description: Agency mode only. Create or update a client record for an account-level agent. This does not create a verified Fine Structure user account and does not transfer ownership.

toolsPreview.name: agency_list_clients
toolsPreview.description: Agency mode only. List client records and app handoff status for the authenticated agent.

toolsPreview.name: agency_create_client_app
toolsPreview.description: Agency mode only. Create a new app owned by the agent, start generation, and create a claim link for the client. Ownership transfers only when the invited client logs in with the same email and accepts the claim link.

toolsPreview.name: agency_create_claim_link
toolsPreview.description: Agency mode only. Create a client claim link for an existing app owned by the agent. The client must log in with the invited email before ownership transfers.

toolsPreview.name: agency_get_claim_status
toolsPreview.description: Agency mode only. Inspect one handoff status without exposing the raw claim token.

toolsPreview.name: update_app
toolsPreview.description: Update an existing application with a new prompt. The AI modifies the app based on your instructions. Creates a Saved Version before the update. Returns a job_id - poll get_job_status to track progress.

toolsPreview.name: publish_app
toolsPreview.description: Publish an app - freeze current state and make it live at a URL. Also configures whether the public URL is open, app-login gated, private, or inferred from the app.

toolsPreview.name: get_platform_guide
toolsPreview.description: Return a machine-readable Fine Structure / FSe2 guide for AI agents. Call this at the start of an MCP session to learn app files, entities, safe edit workflows, validation, publishing, A/B testing, secrets, and platform rules.

toolsPreview.name: get_recommended_workflow
toolsPreview.description: Return the recommended MCP tool sequence for a task type. Use this before creating apps, editing files, seeding data, publishing, setting up A/B tests, restoring versions, or configuring secrets/integrations.

toolsPreview.name: get_job_status
toolsPreview.description: Poll the status of an async generation job. Use this after create_app or update_app to know when the job is done. Returns status ('running' or 'done'), progress events, and result summary when complete.

toolsPreview.name: get_app_status
toolsPreview.description: Get app overview: files, published state, URL, active jobs.

toolsPreview.name: get_app_links
toolsPreview.description: Return editor, preview, published path, subdomain, and custom-domain links plus whether each works for anonymous visitors, app users, or Studio users based on publish and auth settings.

toolsPreview.name: list_app_domains
toolsPreview.description: List an app's platform path, subdomain, and configured custom domain with verification, SSL, primary-domain, redirect, publish, and login-gating status.

toolsPreview.name: add_custom_domain
toolsPreview.description: Attach or replace the app custom domain through the same Fine Structure Studio custom-domain flow. Returns exact DNS verification and routing records for the user to configure at their DNS provider.

toolsPreview.name: get_domain_verification
toolsPreview.description: Return the exact DNS records and instructions required to verify and route the app custom domain.

toolsPreview.name: check_domain_verification
toolsPreview.description: Check Fine Structure custom-domain verification and SSL status for the configured custom domain, then save the latest status.

toolsPreview.name: set_primary_domain
toolsPreview.description: Set which app host should be treated as primary for generated links and custom-domain redirects.

toolsPreview.name: remove_custom_domain
toolsPreview.description: Remove the configured custom domain from the app and clean up the platform-side hostname registration when possible.

toolsPreview.name: get_domain_ssl_status
toolsPreview.description: Return SSL/certificate status and pending certificate validation DNS records for the app custom domain.

toolsPreview.name: configure_domain_redirects
toolsPreview.description: Configure custom-domain redirect policy: primary domain, optional www/root redirect, and HTTPS enforcement.

toolsPreview.name: list_apps
toolsPreview.description: List applications owned by the authenticated user, newest activity first. Returns up to `limit` apps per call plus the total count; page with `offset` when the account has more.

toolsPreview.name: get_app_files
toolsPreview.description: Get the file tree for an app with paths and byte sizes.

toolsPreview.name: read_app_file
toolsPreview.description: Read one source file from an app's virtual filesystem. Paths follow the Fine Structure app file API, documented at https://finestructure.ai/api/mcp/docs.

toolsPreview.name: read_app_files
toolsPreview.description: Read several source files from an app's virtual filesystem. Paths follow the Fine Structure app file API, documented at https://finestructure.ai/api/mcp/docs.

toolsPreview.name: write_app_file
toolsPreview.description: Create or replace one file in an app's virtual filesystem. Creates a Saved Version before changing content. Paths and file model follow the Fine Structure app file API, documented at https://finestructure.ai/api/mcp/docs.

toolsPreview.name: patch_app_file
toolsPreview.description: Patch one file by replacing exact text. Safer than full overwrite for targeted edits. Creates a Saved Version before changing content. Paths follow the Fine Structure app file API, documented at https://finestructure.ai/api/mcp/docs.

toolsPreview.name: rename_app_file
toolsPreview.description: Rename or move one app source file atomically. Internally stages an upsert at new_path and a delete at old_path, validates the resulting app state, and creates a Saved Version before applying.

toolsPreview.name: get_app_detail
toolsPreview.description: Deep introspection of an app: entities, pages, settings, integrations, environment variables, and file structure. Use this to understand what an app contains before updating it.

toolsPreview.name: get_entities
toolsPreview.description: Get all entity (data model) schemas for an app, with record counts. Each entity has fields, types, and relationships.

toolsPreview.name: query_entity
toolsPreview.description: Query app data records for one entity with optional exact-match filters.

toolsPreview.name: seed_entity
toolsPreview.description: Compatibility tool for starter-record creation. Inserts directly for the authenticated app owner; by default it only seeds an empty entity (skip_if_not_empty).

toolsPreview.name: create_entity_records
toolsPreview.description: Create/insert records in one app entity. Executes directly for the authenticated app owner and returns the created record ids.

toolsPreview.name: update_entity_record
toolsPreview.description: Compatibility tool that updates one record by ID. Executes directly for the authenticated app owner.

toolsPreview.name: update_entity_records
toolsPreview.description: Update exact records. Select explicit record_ids or exact-match filters and provide shared changes, or provide per-record updates. Executes directly for the authenticated app owner; expected_count aborts the write on a mismatch.

toolsPreview.name: delete_entity_records
toolsPreview.description: Delete exact records by ID or exact-match filters. Executes directly for the authenticated app owner; pass expected_count as a safety check to abort on a mismatch.

toolsPreview.name: get_pages
toolsPreview.description: Get all pages in an app with their file paths and sizes.

toolsPreview.name: get_errors
toolsPreview.description: Get recent runtime errors for an app (last 20). Useful for diagnosing issues before updating.

toolsPreview.name: get_app_analytics
toolsPreview.description: Traffic analytics for an app's published site over a chosen window: total views, unique visitors, daily series, top pages, top referrer domains and device split.

toolsPreview.name: get_preview_url
toolsPreview.description: Return editor preview and published/public URLs for an app.

toolsPreview.name: list_saved_versions
toolsPreview.description: List restorable Saved Versions for an app, including versions created by MCP writes.

toolsPreview.name: create_change_set
toolsPreview.description: Create a staged file change set. Add multiple file changes, validate them as one app state, then apply atomically.

toolsPreview.name: add_file_change
toolsPreview.description: Stage one file upsert or delete inside a change set. Does not modify the live app until apply_change_set. Paths follow the Fine Structure app file API, documented at https://finestructure.ai/api/mcp/docs.

toolsPreview.name: validate_change_set
toolsPreview.description: Validate current app files plus staged change set files before applying.

toolsPreview.name: apply_change_set
toolsPreview.description: Apply a staged change set to the app. Creates a Saved Version before applying. Blocks on validation errors unless force=true.

toolsPreview.name: discard_change_set
toolsPreview.description: Discard a pending staged change set without changing app files.

toolsPreview.name: validate_app
toolsPreview.description: Run deterministic app checks: syntax, imports, routes/pages, entity schemas, missing entities, and recorded runtime errors.

toolsPreview.name: inspect_preview
toolsPreview.description: Return server-side preview context: URLs, persisted runtime/network errors, static clickable candidates, pages, and explicit live-browser availability.

toolsPreview.name: get_app_security_context
toolsPreview.description: Return safe security context for one owned app: owner id/email, Studio collaborators, generated-app members, route policies, entity policies, and recent security audit entries. Does not return secrets and does not grant access to other apps.

toolsPreview.name: set_route_policy
toolsPreview.description: Create or update a server-owned route policy for a generated app route.

toolsPreview.name: set_entity_policy
toolsPreview.description: Create or update server-side read/write role policy for an app entity.

toolsPreview.name: list_app_members
toolsPreview.description: List generated-app runtime users/members for an app. This is separate from Studio project collaborators.

toolsPreview.name: invite_app_member
toolsPreview.description: Provision a generated-app runtime member with a role. This does not create a Studio collaborator, and the owner role cannot be assigned. Supply password whenever the user can choose one: if it is omitted a temporary password is generated and returned in the result, which puts a live credential into the conversation transcript.

toolsPreview.name: update_app_member_role
toolsPreview.description: Update a generated-app runtime member role. This cannot assign owner and cannot change the Fine Structure account owner.

toolsPreview.name: remove_app_member
toolsPreview.description: Remove a generated-app runtime member.

toolsPreview.name: get_app_security_audit
toolsPreview.description: Read recent server-side security audit events for an app.

toolsPreview.name: compare_saved_versions
toolsPreview.description: Compare two Saved Versions and return per-file additions, removals, modifications, and compact diffs.

toolsPreview.name: compare_current_to_version
toolsPreview.description: Compare the current app files to a Saved Version and return compact per-file diffs.

toolsPreview.name: restore_file_from_version
toolsPreview.description: Restore one file from a Saved Version instead of restoring the entire app. Creates a Saved Version before changing the file. Paths follow the Fine Structure app file API, documented at https://finestructure.ai/api/mcp/docs.

toolsPreview.name: create_entity_schema
toolsPreview.description: Create an entity schema file in entities/<Entity>.json. Creates a Saved Version before writing.

toolsPreview.name: update_entity_schema
toolsPreview.description: Replace or shallow-merge an existing entity schema file. Creates a Saved Version before writing.

toolsPreview.name: validate_entity_relationships
toolsPreview.description: Validate entity relationship metadata and *_id references against existing entity schemas.

toolsPreview.name: update_entity_metadata
toolsPreview.description: Set relationship/index metadata on an entity schema. This stores metadata in the schema file; DB index creation is automatic where supported by the platform.

toolsPreview.name: list_secret_keys
toolsPreview.description: List secret key names for an app. Secret values are never returned.

toolsPreview.name: set_secret
toolsPreview.description: Create or update one encrypted app secret. The secret value is never returned.

toolsPreview.name: delete_secret
toolsPreview.description: Delete one app secret by key.

toolsPreview.name: list_integrations
toolsPreview.description: List supported integrations and safe connected integration metadata for an app. Tokens/secrets are never returned.

toolsPreview.name: configure_integration
toolsPreview.description: Store safe non-secret integration metadata for an app. Use set_secret for API keys/tokens.

toolsPreview.name: list_ab_tests
toolsPreview.description: List the platform A/B tests configured for an app.

toolsPreview.name: create_ab_test
toolsPreview.description: Create a native Fine Structure A/B test between existing app pages. Use update_app first if a variant page still needs to be generated. Creates a Saved Version before the change.

toolsPreview.name: update_ab_test
toolsPreview.description: Update a native A/B test, including active state, variants, traffic, and conversion goal. Creates a Saved Version before the change.

toolsPreview.name: delete_ab_test
toolsPreview.description: Delete a native A/B test from an app. Creates a Saved Version before the change.

toolsPreview.name: get_ab_test_stats
toolsPreview.description: Get views, unique visitors, conversions, and conversion rates for an A/B test.

toolsPreview.name: create_agent
toolsPreview.description: Create an autonomous AI agent on the user's Fine Structure account: a standing worker, not a chat session. It gets the platform's default safe tool policy and its own email address, it can read and write the app database, and once the owner phone is verified (see get_agent_whatsapp) it can message its owner on WhatsApp and by email through the platform system channels. Pair it with schedule_agent_task for recurring work such as following up new leads on WhatsApp each morning, watching an app for runtime errors, or sending a weekly summary. Messaging anyone other than the verified owner requires a channel the owner connects in the Fine Structure Studio.

toolsPreview.name: list_agents
toolsPreview.description: List the AI agents on the user's account with id, name, role, status and FineMail address.

toolsPreview.name: schedule_agent_task
toolsPreview.description: Create a scheduled task for one of the user's agents. Supported schedule types: once (run_at ISO local time + timezone), interval (interval_minutes 5-1440), hourly, daily (time HH:MM + timezone), weekly (time + timezone + days_of_week 0=Sunday..6), cron (5-field expression + timezone), manual (only runs on demand). Returns the normalized schedule and the computed next_run_at so you can read the fire time back to the user in their timezone.

toolsPreview.name: list_agent_tasks
toolsPreview.description: List scheduled tasks for one agent (or the whole account), including schedule, status and next_run_at.

toolsPreview.name: get_agent_whatsapp
toolsPreview.description: Read the WhatsApp state of the connected account: whether the owner's phone is verified, which platform numbers they can connect, and which conversations already route to which agent. Call this first whenever the user asks to talk to an agent on WhatsApp, and repeat its next_step to them.

toolsPreview.name: start_owner_phone_verification
toolsPreview.description: Send a 6-digit code over WhatsApp to the ACCOUNT OWNER's own phone. This is the one-time ownership proof required before a platform number can be connected, and it also unlocks agents messaging the owner. Ask the user for their own WhatsApp number first and send only to that. No WhatsApp Business account is involved.

toolsPreview.name: confirm_owner_phone_verification
toolsPreview.description: Confirm the 6-digit code the owner received on WhatsApp from start_owner_phone_verification. On success the owner is verified: agents can message them, and platform numbers become connectable.

toolsPreview.name: attach_agent_whatsapp
toolsPreview.description: Connect a platform WhatsApp number to one of the account's agents, so the owner can message that number and reach that agent. Requires the owner to be verified first. Take phone_number_id from get_agent_whatsapp. A number already used by another account is still valid to connect: it answers only this owner's verified phone.

toolsPreview.name: detach_agent_whatsapp
toolsPreview.description: Disconnect the owner's WhatsApp route from a platform number. Removes only this account's route; other accounts sharing the number keep theirs.
